body.x: Plantronics(www.plantronics.com) showcased wireless speakerphone ‘Calisto 620’ at '2014 International CES', the biggest IT∙appliances show held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.

This portable wireless UC speakerphone instantly transforms a laptop or smartphone into a high-quality conferencing device. It is designed to simplify call management with an easy interface for answer/end, mute and volume and it comes with a Bluetooth® mini USB adapter for always-ready PC connectivity.

'CES(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
